_comment: Outside skill/agent libraries the AIBAST Agents Library aggregates.
Adding a source is a config edit, not a code change — scripts/crawl_skills.py
reads this file on the daily metrics run.
THE LIBRARY INDEXES, IT DOES NOT MIRROR. Only catalog metadata is stored:
name, description, tags, author, a link back to the origin, and any counts
the source itself publishes. Skill bodies and source files are never copied
into this repo by the crawler. An aggregated skill enters the library proper
only through the conversion pipeline (docs/AGGREGATION.md): converted to a
RAPP-compliant single-file skill.md or agent.py, passed through the quality
gates, and submitted as a normal publisher PR with attribution and a
compatible license. `license_verified: false` means treat the origin as
all-rights-reserved: index and link only, never convert without permission.

sources.license_note: Pages site and skills.json are publicly served; repository LICENSE not programmatically readable. Index-only until verified.
